text:
ida: FYI: vendor webhook logs surfaced a KMS-wrapped secret and an old service-account JSON in a partner dump. appears in a gzipped archive they shared for onboarding.

ops-bot: Alert: artifact-scan found file matching pattern '.*service-account.*.json' inside vendor-archive-2026-05-10.tar.gz (scan id sc-1122).

cole: Is this prod or staging artifact?

ida: It was in the onboarding bundle they sent (staging), but the SA referenced prod-k8s access. Treat as prod-impact until confirmed.

marta: Plan: (1) ask vendor to pause sharing and revoke the blob, (2) rotate the exposed SA keys, (3) rewrap any Vault ciphertext that used that SA for wrap/unwrapping, (4) run a partner-wide artifact search for similar leaks. I'll own rewrap.

vendor-liaison: I've asked vendor to stop distribution and to provide an MD5 manifest of what they uploaded. Vendor paused within 20m.

cole: Commands to rotate and deny quickly:
```
# delete keys
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=partner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete {} --iam-account=partner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com || true
# deny binding
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod --member=serviceAccount:partner-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/denyAll || true
```

ida: Also we need a Vault token revocation sweep for any tokens issued to that SA and require rebind of any KMS wrap keys.

marta: Rewrap plan: schedule a transit rewrap job that re-encrypts all archives using new wrap key version. We'll throttle to 5/min. I'll publish a signed manifest to secure-analytics.

cole: Quick detection snippets to run across partner dumps:
```
# look for JSON blobs
zgrep -aE "\"private_key\"|\"client_email\"" partner-dumps/*.gz || true
```

vendor-liaison: Vendor provided a partial manifest. They found 3 archives referencing the SA. They agree to run a clean build and re-upload only after we confirm rewrap.

ida: Marking incident INC-2026-4410, priority=P1. oncall please open.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-4410 assigned to eng-security.

marta: Rewrap started: 3/3 archives queued, progress 1/3. Throttling in case partner systems call unwrap frequently.

cole: Add short-term guard: set conditional IAM to deny external callers from using the backup-wrap key except from internal IPs. Then we can rotate later.

ida: Agree. Also file follow-ups: require vendor onboarding checklist to forbid service-account artifacts, add CI image scanning for baked credentials, and a quarterly rotation drill.

marta: Rewrap done 3/3. publishing manifest and checksums. vendor-liaison: please confirm vendor only pulls rewrapped artifacts.

vendor-liaison: Vendor confirmed and removed old bundles. They requested sanitized build instructions; I'll share them.

ida: Closing containment. Postmortem owners: ida + marta. Thanks everyone.
